name: Recycling
highLevelGoals: Enable users to easily find nearby recycling centers, view their operational details, and access location maps to promote convenient recycling.
Allow users to manage their recycling preferences, save favorite facilities, and receive relevant notifications to enhance their recycling experience.
Maintain current and reliable data for all recycling facilities, including operational hours, accepted materials, and event schedules.
Provide channels for users to submit feedback and for administrators to respond, fostering continuous improvement of the service.
Allow facility representatives to directly update and maintain their facility's details, ensuring accuracy and reducing administrative overhead.
lowLevelGoals: The system shall allow a user to retrieve a list of recycling facilities within a specified radius of their current location.
The system shall allow a user to view the operational hours, contact information, and accepted materials for a selected recycling facility.
The system shall allow a user to generate a map displaying the location of a selected recycling facility and provide navigation options.
The system shall allow a user to set their preferred recyclable materials to filter facility search results.
The system shall allow a user to save a recycling facility to their list of favorite facilities for quick access.
The system shall send a notification to a user when there are updates to their saved favorite facilities or relevant recycling events.
The system shall allow an administrator to add new recycling facility records, including name, address, and initial operational details.
The system shall allow an administrator to modify the operational hours for an existing recycling facility.
The system shall allow an administrator to add or remove accepted materials for an existing recycling facility.
The system shall allow an administrator to schedule and publish details for a new recycling event associated with a facility.
The system shall allow an administrator to receive and view feedback submitted by users.
The system shall allow an administrator to compose and send a response to a specific user feedback submission.
The system shall allow a facility representative to update the contact details (e.g., phone number, email) for their assigned facility.
The system shall allow a facility representative to add or remove materials accepted for recycling at their facility.
The system shall allow a facility representative to modify the daily or weekly operating hours for their facility.
